# Selemene Engine

> Computational mirror for self-inquiry. 16 live consciousness engines with sub-ms calculations. REST API with witness prompts calibrated to consciousness level.

Selemene Engine is a high-performance Rust + TypeScript API serving 16 calculation engines (11 Rust + 5 TypeScript) rooted in Vedic, numerological, and consciousness traditions. Each response includes a witness prompt — a question calibrated to your awareness level.

## API Documentation

- [OpenAPI Spec](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/openapi.json): Full machine-readable API specification
- [Swagger UI](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/docs): Interactive API explorer
- [API Quickstart](https://github.com/Sheshiyer/Selemene-engine/blob/main/docs/API_QUICKSTART.md): Zero to first call

## Authentication

- [Auth Guide](https://github.com/Sheshiyer/Selemene-engine/blob/main/README.md#authentication): API Key (X-API-Key header) or JWT Bearer token

## Engines

- [Panchanga](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/engines/panchanga/info): Vedic calendar — tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana
- [Human Design](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/engines/human-design/info): Bodygraph — type, strategy, authority, profile
- [Gene Keys](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/engines/gene-keys/info): Shadow-Gift-Siddhi activation sequences
- [Vimshottari](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/engines/vimshottari/info): 120-year planetary dasha timeline
- [Numerology](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/engines/numerology/info): Life path, expression, soul urge numbers
- [Biorhythm](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/engines/biorhythm/info): Physical, emotional, intellectual cycles
- [Vedic Clock](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/engines/vedic-clock/info): Muhurta, hora, dosha timing
- [Biofield](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/engines/biofield/info): Chakra energy readings
- [Face Reading](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/engines/face-reading/info): Facial feature analysis and personality insights
- [Nadabrahman](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/engines/nadabrahman/info): Sound and vibration frequency analysis
- [Transits](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/engines/transits/info): Planetary transit calculations and predictions
- [Enneagram](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/engines/enneagram/info): Personality type and growth path mapping
- [I-Ching](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/engines/i-ching/info): Hexagram divination and change patterns
- [Sacred Geometry](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/engines/sacred-geometry/info): Geometric pattern and ratio analysis
- [Sigil Forge](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/engines/sigil-forge/info): Intention sigil creation and activation
- [Tarot](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/engines/tarot/info): Card spread readings and archetypal guidance

## Workflows

- [Birth Blueprint](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/workflows/birth-blueprint/info): Numerology + Human Design + Vimshottari
- [Daily Practice](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/workflows/daily-practice/info): Panchanga + Vedic Clock + Biorhythm
- [Full Spectrum](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/workflows/full-spectrum/info): All engines combined
- [Decision Support](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/workflows/decision-support/info): Multi-engine guidance for choices and timing
- [Self Inquiry](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/workflows/self-inquiry/info): Reflective prompts across consciousness systems
- [Creative Expression](https://selemene.tryambakam.space/api/v1/workflows/creative-expression/info): Archetypal and symbolic creative guidance
